chen po myi sdug go zhes bya bar rtog pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myi rtag go zhes bya bar ston/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar ston/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams bdag myed do zhes bya bar ston/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myi sdug go zhes bya bar ston cing / 'di skad du gang de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes rjod de/ su la bstan pa de dag kyang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myi rtag ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sdug bsngal zhes bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams bdag myed ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myi sdug ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de dag sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myi rtag go zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams bdag myed do zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myi sdug go zhes bya bar rtog pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myi rtag go zhes bya bar ston/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar ston/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu bdag myed do zhes bya bar ston/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myi sdug go zhes bya bar ston cing / 'di skad du gang de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes rjod de/ su la bstan pa de dag kyang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myi rtag ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal zhes bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu bdag myed ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myi sdug ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de dag rgyun tu zhugs

pa'i 'bras bu myi rtag go zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu bdag myed do zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myi sdug go zhes bya bar rtog pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi rtag go zhes bya bar ston/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar ston/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bdag myed do zhes bya bar ston/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mi sdug go zhes bya bar ston cing / 'di skad du gang de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes rjod de/ su la bstan pa de dag kyang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi rtag ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal zhes bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bdag myed ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi sdug ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de dag lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi rtag go zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bdag myed do zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi sdug go zhes bya bar rtog pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi rtag go zhes bya bar ston/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar ston/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bdag myed do zhes bya bar ston/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi sdug go zhes bya bar ston cing / 'di skad du gang de ltar spyod pa na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes rjod de/ su la bstan pa de dag kyang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi rtag ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal

zhes bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bdag myed ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi sdug ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de dag phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi rtag go zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bdag myed do zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi sdug go zhes bya bar rtog pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid myi rtag go zhes bya bar ston/ dgra bcom pa nyid sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar ston/ dgra bcom pa nyid bdag myed do zhes bya bar ston/ dgra bcom pa nyid myi sdug go zhes bya bar ston cing / 'di skad du gang de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes rjod de/ su la bstan pa de dag kyang / dgra bcom pa nyid myi rtag ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid sdug bsngal zhes bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid bdag myed ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid myi sdug ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de dag dgra bcom pa nyid myi rtag go zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid bdag myed do zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid myi sdug go zhes bya bar rtog pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /rang byang chub myi rtag go zhes bya bar ston/ rang byang chub sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar ston/ rang byang chub bdag myed do zhes bya bar ston/ rang byang chub myi sdug go zhes bya bar ston cing / 'di skad du gang de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes rjod de/ su la bstan pa de dag kyang / rang byang chub myi rtag ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /rang byang chub sdug bsngal zhes bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /rang

byang chub bdag myed ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /rang byang chub myi sdug ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de dag rang byang chub myi rtag go zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / rang byang chub sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / rang byang chub bdag myed do zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / rang byang chub myi sdug go zhes bya bar rtog pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myi rtag go zhes bya bar ston/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar ston/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid bdag myed do zhes bya bar ston/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myi sdug go zhes bya bar ston cing / 'di skad du gang de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes rjod de/ su la bstan pa de dag kyang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myi rtag ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid sdug bsngal zhes bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid bdag myed ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myi sdug ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de dag lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myi rtag go zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid bdag myed do zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myi sdug go zhes bya bar rtog pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mi rtag go zhes bya bar ston/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar ston/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bdag myed do zhes bya bar ston/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi sdug go zhes bya bar ston cing / 'di skad du gang de ltar spyod pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes rjod de/ su la bstan pa de

dag kyang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi rtag ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sdug bsngal zhes bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bdag myed ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi sdug ces bya bar rtog par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de dag rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi rtag go zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sdug bsngal lo zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bdag myed do zhes bya bar rtog pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi sdug go zhes bya bar rtog pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod par 'gyur te/ kau shi ka de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan no/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston na 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig /khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa dang / sa gsum pa dang / sa bzhi pa dang / sa lnga pa dang / sa drug pa dang / sa bdun pa dang / sa brgyad pa dang / sa dgu pa dang / sa bcu pa la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tshur rigs kyi bu bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig /khyod kyis bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa dang / sa gsum pa dang / sa bzhi pa dang / sa lnga pa dang / sa drug pa dang / sa bdun pa dang / sa brgyad pa dang / sa dgu pa dang / sa bcu pa la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tshur rigs kyi bu brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig /khyod kyis brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa

gnyis pa dang / sa gsum pa dang / sa bzhi pa dang / sa lnga pa dang / sa drug pa dang / sa bdun pa dang / sa brgyad pa dang / sa dgu pa dang / sa bcu pa la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tshur rigs kyi bu bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig /khyod kyis bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa dang / sa gsum pa dang / sa bzhi pa dang / sa lnga pa dang / sa drug pa dang / sa bdun pa dang / sa brgyad pa dang / sa dgu pa dang / sa bcu pa la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tshur rigs kyi bu tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/khyod kyis tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa dang / sa gsum pa dang / sa bzhi pa dang / sa lnga pa dang / sa drug pa dang / sa bdun pa dang / sa brgyad pa dang / sa dgu pa dang / sa bcu pa la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tshur rigs kyi bu sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ khyod kyis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa dang / sa gsum pa dang / sa bzhi pa dang / sa lnga pa dang / sa drug pa dang / sa bdun pa dang / sa brgyad pa dang / sa dgu pa dang / sa bcu pa la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes de yang mtshan ma'i tshul dang / dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston te/ de dus kyi 'du shes kyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom par 'gyur te/ kau shi ka de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan no/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms

shig/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms dang / nyan thos kyi sa las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'da' bar 'gyur ro zhes ston te/ kau shi ka de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan no/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston na/ 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms dang / byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis de ltar myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa la gnas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur ro zhes/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag la ston na 'di skad ston te/ rigs kyi bu dag su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'dzin cing / 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de ni/ bsod nams kyi phung po tshad myed grangs myed dpag tu myed par 'gyur ro zhes zer te/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag la ston na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag la 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas

rnams kyis thugs dang po bskyed pa nas/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar gyi/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus te/ rjes su dga' bar gyis la/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngos shig ces rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag de ltar ston cing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ston to/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar ston na/ rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan mi ston pa lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas na rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ gzugs myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzugs ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ gzugs kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po med pa gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni gzugs rtag ces bya ba 'am/ myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la gzugs nyid kyang myed na/ rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/

tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ tshor ba myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshor ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ tshor ba'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po med pa'o/ /dngos po med pa gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ tshor ba rtag ces bya ba 'am/ myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la tshor ba nyid kyang myed na/ rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ 'du shes myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'du shes ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ 'du shes kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ 'du shes rtag ces bya ba 'am/ myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la 'du shes nyid kyang myed na/ rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ 'du byed myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'du byed ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ 'du byed kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ 'du byed rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la 'du byed nyid kyang myed na/ rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ rnam par shes pa myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rnam par shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ rnam par shes pa rtag ces bya ba 'am/ myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la rnam par shes pa nyid kyang myed na/ rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ myig myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ myig ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ myig gi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos

kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig /nam mkha'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nam mkha'i khams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ nam mkha'i khams rtag ces bya ba 'am mi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la nam mkha'i khams nyid kyang myed na/ rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa ba'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ rnam par shes pa'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rnam par shes pa'i khams ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ rnam par shes pa'i khams rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la rnam par shes pa'i khams nyid kyang myed na/ rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ /kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i

rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa ba'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ ma rig pa myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma rig pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ ma rig pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ ma rig pa rtag ces bya ba 'am/ myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la ma rig pa nyid kyang myed na/ rtag pa 'am/ myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig /'du byed myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'du byed ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ 'du byed kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ 'du byed rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la 'du byed nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang

chub sems dpa'i theg pa ba'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ rnam pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ rnam par shes pa rtag ces bya ba 'am/ myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la rnam par shes pa nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ mying dang gzugs myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mying dang gzugs ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ mying dang gzugs kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni mying dang gzugs rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la mying dang gzugs nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms mched drug myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ skye mched drug ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ skye mched drug gi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni skye mched drug rtag ces bya ba 'am/ myi rtag ces bya ba mi dmyigs so/ /de la skye mched drug nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan mi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ reg pa myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ reg pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ reg pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ reg pa rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la reg pa nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan mi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ tshor ba myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshor ba ni rang bzhin

gyis stong ste/ tshor ba'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni tshor ba rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la tshor ba nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ sred pa myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sred pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ sred pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ sred pa rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la sred pa nyid kyang myed na/ rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ len pa myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ len pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ len pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni len pa rtag ces bya ba 'am/ myi rtag ces bya ba

myi dmyigs so/ /de la len pa nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ srid pa myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srid pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ srid pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni srid pa rtag ces bya ba 'am/ myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la srid pa nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ skye ba myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ skye ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ skye ba'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po med pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni skye ba rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la skye ba nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am/ myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu

dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ rga shi myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rga shi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ rga shi'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni rga shi rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la rga shi nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba mi dmigs so/ /de la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myi rtag ces bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma lta shig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rtag ces bya ba 'am myi rtag ces bya ba myi dmyigs so/ /de la bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang myed na rtag pa 'am myi rtag pa lta ga la yod ces ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de

rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ston te/ tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgoms shig/ chos gang las kyang yongs su 'da' bar ma byed cig/ chos gang las kyang gnas par ma byed cig/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chos gang las 'da' bar bya ba 'am gang la gnas par bya ba'i chos de la myed de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i chos gang yin pa de ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de la ni/ blang bar bya ba 'am/ dor bar bya ba 'am/ bskyed par bya ba 'am dgag par bya ba'i chos gang yang myed do zhes ston te/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan myi ston to/ /kau shi ka de bas na rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mos de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bstan par bya ste/ kau shi ka de ltar ston pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi bsod nams kyi phung po ni ches mang du 'phel gyi/ rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo snga ma dag gi ni ma yin no/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang 'dzam bu gling gi sems can ji snyed pa de dag rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod na/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan/ yi ge dang ldan par gzhan la rgya cher brjod de bstan pa dang / bshad de

rnams thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe khyod kyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos rnams thob par gyur pa de'i tshe/ khyod bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes bsgo na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'bring po'i sems can rnams bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs par gyur pa lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs par gyur te/ de dag la rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par gzhan la rgya cher brjod de bstan pa dang / bshad de bkrol zhing rnam par phye ste gsal ba dang / yang dag par bstan pa byas pa dang / 'di skad du tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zung shig/ kun chub par gyis shig/ chongs shig/ lhogs shig/ tshul bzhin du yid la gyis shig/ ji ltar bstan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la nan tan du gyis shig/ rigs kyi bu khyod gang gi tshe shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ji ltar bstan pa la nan tan byed pa de'i tshe/ rigs kyi bu khyod shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu khyod gang gi tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob par gyur pa de'i tshe/ khyod kyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos rnams thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe khyod kyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos rnams thob par gyur pa de'i tshe/ khyod bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes bsgo na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par

zhugs par gyur pa lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs par gyur te/ de dag la rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par gzhan la rgya cher brjod de bstan pa dang / bshad de bkrol zhing rnam par phye ste gsal ba dang / yang dag par bstan pa byas pa dang / 'di skad du tshur rigs kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zung shig/ kun chub par gyis shig/ chongs shig/ lhogs shig/ tshul bzhin du yid la gyis shig/ ji ltar bstan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la nan tan du gyis shig/ rigs kyi bu khyod gang gi tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ji ltar bstan pa la nan tan byed pa de'i tshe/ rigs kyi bu khyod shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu khyod gang gi tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob par gyur pa de'i tshe/ khyod kyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos rnams thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe khyod kyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos rnams thob par gyur pa de'i tshe/ khyod bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes bsgo na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang 'dzam bu gling gi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di/ don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan pa dang / bshad de bkrol zhing rnam par phye ste gsal ba dang / yang dag par bstan pa byas pa bas/ de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la la zhig/ 'di skad du bdag myur du

bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes zer la rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan/ yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan na rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur pa lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan pa dang / bshad de bkrol zhing rnam par phye ste gsal ba dang / yang dag par bstan pa byas pa bas/ de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la la zhig 'di skad du bdag myur du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes zer la rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur pa lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams byur bu'i sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher/ brjod de bstan pa dang / bshad de bkrol zhing rnam par phye ste gsal

ba dang / yang dag par bstan pa byas pa bas/ de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la la zhig 'di skad du/ bdag myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes zer la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams byur bu'i sems can rnams bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur pa lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'bring po'i sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan pa dang / bshad de bkrol zhing rnam par phye ste gsal ba dang / yang dag par bstan pa byas pa bas/ de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la la zhig/ 'di skad du bdag myur du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes zer la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan na rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'bring po'i sems can rnams bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur pa lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang

dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan pa dang / bshad de bkrol zhing rnam par phye ste gsal ba dang / yang dag par bstan pa byas pa bas/ de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la la zhig 'di skad du/ bdag myur du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes zer la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan na rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur pa lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan pa dang / bshad de bkrol zhing rnam par phye ste gsal ba dang / yang dag par bstan pa byas pa bas/ de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la la zhig 'di skad du/ bdag myur du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes zer la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di don dang

ldan yi ge dang ldan par rgya cher brjod de bstan na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag ni nges pa ste/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu gzhol zhing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par myi 'gyur bas na/ de dag la ni da gdod tshos bstan kyang mi dgos kyi/ 'di ni 'khor ba las 'byung bar 'dod la/ snying rje chen pos mnar ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji lta ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nye bar gyur pa/ de lta de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /ji lta ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nye bar gyur pa de lta de ltar nang stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar phyi stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar chen po stong pa nyid la gdams

shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de ltar de ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de lta de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /dbang po rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /stobs rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /bsam gtan rnams la

gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /tshad myed pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /byams pa chen po la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /snying rje chen po la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'o/ /gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal cha dang / nad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad kyis kyang rjes su gzung bar bgyi ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la chos kyis bsdu ba dang / zang zing gis bsdu bas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi bsod nams ches mang du 'phel gyi/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo snga ma dag gi ni ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni yong yang de ltar 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang lags pa de ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin

pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /nang stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /phyi stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /chen po stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /dbang po rnams la gdams

shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /stobs rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /bsam gtan rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /tshad myed pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa med pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /byams pa chen po la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /snying rje chen po la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la gdams shing rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la smras pa/ kau shi ka de ltar khyod byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mos pa bskyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phan 'dogs pa dang / yongs su skyob pa legs so legs so/ /kau shi ka khyod kyis de bzhin

du bya'o/ /'phags pa nyan thos gang sems can rnams la phan 'dogs par 'dod pa des kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mos pa bskyed par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams zang zing dang chos kyis phan gdags pas phan gdags shing yongs su bskyang bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bcom ldan 'das kyis nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag las 'byung ngo / /gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems mi bskyed na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag la slob pa ma yin/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan

lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad myed pa rnams dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la slob pa ma yin te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar myi 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur na/ rang sangs rgyas dang / nyan thos rnams kyang yod par myi 'gyur te/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag la yang slob la/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /

dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad myed pa rnams dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la yang slob pas/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/ sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi rgyun 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /byol song gi skye gnas rnams kyi rgyun 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten rnams kyi rgyun 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /lha ma yin gyi ris kyang yongs su 'grib par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i ris kyang mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phrul

dge'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chung snang gi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chung dge'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chung che'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'og min gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du

'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po rnams 'jig rten du

'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa med pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snying rje chen po 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ brgya byin gyi le'u ste/ nyi shu gsum mo// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po dgu pa/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas gnas brtan rab 'byor la

smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba gang yin pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gang yin pa dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyi sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / tshul khrims las byung ba dang / bsgom pa las byung ba'i/ bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gang yin pa de dag las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos pa 'di nyid rab ces bya'o/ /dam pa zhes bya'o/ /gtso bo zhes bya'o/ /mchog ces bya'o/ /phul zhes bya'o/ /gya nom pa zhes bya'o/ /bla na myed pa zhes bya'o/ /gong na myed pa zhes bya'o/ /mnyam pa myed pa zhes bya'o/ /myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyi sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / tshul khrims las byung ba dang / bsgom pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ni/ bdag gdul ba dang / bdag zhi bar bya ba dang / bdag yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir/ nye bar gnas pa ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag

brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa drug dag kyang / bdag gdul ba dang / bdag zhi bar bya ba dang / bdag yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir/ /nye bar gnas par zad kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can thams cad gdul ba dang / zhi bar bya ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed tshad myed dpag tu myed pa dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs myed tshad myed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de dag dang / lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed tshad myed dpag tu myed pa dag gi/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs myed tshad myed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de dag dang / nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed tshad myed dpag tu myed pa dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs myed tshad myed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de dag dang / byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed tshad myed dpag tu myed pa dag gi/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang / sangs rgyas

bcom ldan 'das grangs myed tshad myed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de dag dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed tshad myed dpag tu myed pa dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs myed tshad myed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de dag dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed tshad myed dpag tu myed pa dag gi/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med tshad myed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de dag dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed tshad med dpag tu myed pa dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs myed tshad myed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de dag dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed tshad myed dpag tu myed pa dag gi/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs myed tshad myed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de dag dang / 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed tshad myed dpag tu myed pa dag gi/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs myed/ tshad myed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de dag dang / steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs myed tshad myed dpag tu myed pa dag gis/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs myed tshad myed pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de dag thugs dang po bskyed pa nas/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bar dang / phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar gyi dam pa'i chos ma

nub kyi bar du/ dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa gang ji snyed cig yod pa dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa de dag gis/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / bsgom pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / slob pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba zag pa myed pa dag dang / myi slob pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba zag pa myed pa dag dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gi/ tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po dang / phan par bzhed pa dang / thugs rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos grangs myed tshad myed pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis chos gang bstan pa dang chos bstan pa de la bslabs shing / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid thob pa dang / rang byang chub thob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed pa la zhugs pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ji snyed pa dang / gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa de dag bzhugs kyang rung / yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang rung ste/ de dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ji snyed cig bskyed pa de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus te/ rjes su yid rang ba'i mchog/ gtso bo dam pa rab/ phul gya nom pa bla na myed pa gong na myed pa/ mnyam pa myed pa/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pas rjes su yi rang ste/ de ltar rjes su yi rang nas/ rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po de sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub par gyur cig /

ces bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa des de skad du smras te sems kyi rnam pa de lta bus yongs su bsngos na/ dmyigs pa gang dang / dngos po gang dag gis/ sems de lta bu skyes par gyur pa'i dngos po de dag dang / dmyigs pa de dag/ rigs kyi bu de dag gis/ ji ltar mtshan mar byas pa de bzhin du dmyigs su yod pa yin nam/ /byams pas smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu de dag gis/ ji ltar mtshan mar byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos pa de bzhin du dngos po de dag dang / dmigs pa de dag dmyigs su yod pa ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis smras pa/ gal te de ltar dngos po myed pa dag dmyigs pa myed pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa de dag dang de dag gi thugs dang po bskyed pa nas/ dam pa'i chos gnas pa'i bar gyi/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la gnas pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ji snyed pa dang / slob pa rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ji snyed pa dang / myi slob pa rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad gcig tu bstsogs bsdus te bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mtshan ma'i tshul gyis/ yongs su bsngos na/ ji ltar mi rtag pa la rtag go zhes bya bar 'du shes phyin ci log dang / sems phyin ci log dang / lta ba phyin ci log tu gyur pa dang / sdug bsngal ba la bde zhes bya bar 'du shes phyin ci log dang / sems phyin ci log dang / lta ba phyin ci log tu gyur pa dang / bdag myed pa la bdag ces bya bar 'du shes phyin ci log dang / sems phyin ci log dang / lta ba phyin ci log tu gyur pa dang / mi gtsang ba la gtsang

zhes bya bar 'du shes phyin ci log dang / sems phyin ci log dang / lta ba phyin ci log tu gyur pa/ de ltar de'i 'du shes phyin ci log tu ma gyur tam/ /de lta yin yang thams cad dngos po ji lta ba dang / dmyigs pa ji lta bar byang chub kyang de bzhin/ sems kyang de bzhin/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang de bzhin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang de bzhin/ gzugs dang tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang de bzhin/ myig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyang de bzhin/ gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos kyang de bzhin/ khams dang skye mched dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yang de bzhin/ nang stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ phyi stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ chen po stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang de bzhin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ dbang po rnams kyang de bzhin/ stobs rnams kyang de bzhin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang de bzhin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang de

bzhin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ bsam gtan rnams kyang de bzhin/ tshad myed pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang de bzhin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yang de bzhin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa yang de bzhin/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang de bzhin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang de bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yang de bzhin/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi yang de bzhin/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yang de bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyang de bzhin te/ gal te de ltar dngos po ji lta ba dang / dmyigs pa ji lta bar byang chub kyang de bzhin/ sems kyang de bzhin/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang de bzhin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang de bzhin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang de bzhin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang de bzhin/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang de bzhin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang de bzhin/ nang stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ phyi stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ chen po stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ yang dag par spong

ba rnams kyang de bzhin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ dbang po rnams kyang de bzhin/ stobs rnams kyang de bzhin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang de bzhin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang de bzhin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ bsam gtan rnams kyang de bzhin/ tshad myed pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang de bzhin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yang de bzhin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa yang de bzhin/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyang de bzhin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang de bzhin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang de bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yang de bzhin/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi yang de bzhin/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yang de bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyang de bzhin na ni/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba'i dngos po de ni gang zhig yin/ dmyigs pa de ni gang zhig yin/ byang chub de ni gang zhig yin/ sems de ni gang zhig yin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag ni gang zhig yin/ rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po de ni gang zhig yin/ /byams pas smras pa/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod spyod pa/ sangs rgyas mang po bsnyen bkur cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par gyur pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis kyang yongs su zin pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'i chos thams cad la bslabs pa dag ni/ dngos po de dag dang / dmyigs pa de dag dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po de dag mtshan mar byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs
